name: QP / A-COM
one_liner: The deterministic authority and truth kernel beneath autonomous work.
core_thesis: Cost of cognition trends toward zero, but permission to change consequential state remains scarce. Therefore cognition, truth and authority must be separated. Untrusted proposals may only alter canonical state after deterministic gates pass, and external consequences require scoped cryptographic grants. Every accepted transition emits a replayable receipt.
why_now: The rest of the portfolio needs exactly this boundary as agents gain more tools and autonomy.
job: Know exactly what can be believed, committed or executed and why.
distribution: Internal kernel first; reusable protocol/runtime later.
moat: Minimal composable semantics plus evidence/grant/receipt history across real autonomous systems.
falsifiers: Existing authorization/attestation standards fully subsume the runtime semantics.
Deterministic gates cannot capture enough useful acceptance conditions.
